description: This file defines the 'Container' class which manages command execution, credential checks, and provider selection within the openbb platform, specifically for the command runner session.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: Container class for managing command execution, credential validation, and provider selection within the command runner session.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Container with a command runner instance and sets user and system settings.

methods.name: _run
methods.description: Executes a command within the container, applying default parameters and returning output in the specified format.

methods.name: _check_credentials
methods.description: Checks if the required credentials for a given provider are populated.

methods.name: _get_provider
methods.description: Determines the provider to use for a command based on priority and credential availability, raising an error if none are suitable.
